layout_and_navigation.shell: Collapsible Sidebar + Fixed Header Topbar with user role switcher & notification center

key_features_ui_spec.dashboard_kpi: Monthly/Quarterly/Annual filter bar, target vs achievement cards, recharts trend graphs, program completeness gauge, late submission badges.
key_features_ui_spec.pj_report_flow: Step-by-step reporting builder with draft save, submission dialog, revision request notes from Kepala Puskesmas, and approval stamp.
key_features_ui_spec.flexible_tables: Dynamic indicator table, excel import (.xlsx/.csv parser preview modal), excel template download button.
key_features_ui_spec.swot_tows_matrix: Interactive 2x2 grid (Kekuatan, Kelemahan, Peluang, Ancaman) with strategy synthesis cards.
key_features_ui_spec.fishbone_5whys: Visual fishbone diagram (Man, Method, Material, Machine, Environment, Measurement) coupled with 5-Why root cause analysis cards featuring 'Fakta vs Dugaan' validation check.
key_features_ui_spec.slide_presentation: Per-program automated slide deck viewer with inline slide edit mode, slide transition, and full-screen presentation mode.
key_features_ui_spec.export_suite: Export menu dropdown with options for Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PDF, and PPTX.
key_features_ui_spec.followup_monitoring: Kanban board & list view for action items (Tindak Lanjut) with priority tags, pic, deadline, and status.
key_features_ui_spec.revision_history_log: Timeline component showing audit trail, version changes, and timestamped actions.

testing_attributes.rule: MUST include data-testid on every interactive element, input, tab, button, card metric, modal trigger, and table row.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure black or stark gray background; use warm tinted bone (#F8FAF7) in light mode and rich slate/emerald void in dark mode.
Consistently use Bahasa Indonesia terms: 'Puskesmas Melati', 'Penanggung Jawab (PJ)', 'Kepala Puskesmas', 'Capaian', 'Sasaran', 'Target', 'Tindak Lanjut', 'Belum tersedia'.
All interactive elements MUST feature data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Headers and floating overlays MUST have semi-opaque backdrop blurs (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80), NEVER pure transparent.
Ensure responsiveness on mobile & desktop views with generous container padding (p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8).
